rationale: Creates the first externally-reachable HTTP endpoint with new authentication design, qualifying for deep tier as a new trust boundary despite mostly additive changes.

signals.blast_radius: New drafts table, new Draft Generation workflow with HTTP webhook trigger, shared-secret credential, and setup runbook; all additive to existing subsystems.
signals.unresolved: All open questions are tuning details (rate-limiting, sample size, credential custody) that don't change the design; Phase 5 dashboard is deferred but anticipated.
signals.irreversibility: Git revert plus schema drop; no migrations or dependencies on removed capabilities.
